Game Overview

In Butterfly, the core idea is straightforward: glide through a radiant forest as a butterfly, mastering seamless maneuvers to collect mystery points. Navigate vibrant, intricate landscapes with intuitive controls, overcoming enticing challenges while evading obstacles. Test your skills and uncover hidden rewards in this visually stunning, captivating adventure for players of all levels.
